query: when did we change the embedding model for recall

seed_memories.content: When did we change the embedding model for recall? We did the change in v0.18, swapping from text-embedding-ada-002 to text-embedding-3-small. The swap doubled vector dimensions from 1536 to 3072 and required a full reindex via 'rein migrate --reindex'.
seed_memories.summary: When the embedding model changed for recall: v0.18 swap to text-embedding-3-small.
